figures.caption: Table 8: Results of overall diagnosis prediction performance on the MIMIC-IV dataset with 5% training data. The best results are highlighted in bold while the second best are underlined.

Figure 1: Diagnosis Prediction Patterns Across Models. (a) LLMs tend to predict repeating historical diagnoses (e.g., CHD); (b) Deep models are effective at predicting novel diagnoses (e.g., MD) but lack explanation; (c) Our method integrates deep model-guided evidence into LLMs to achieve accurate and explainable predictions (e.g., EPC → MD). (d) Proportion of predictions: historical (solid bars) vs. novel (hatched bars); (e) Overall prediction performance (Precision@10, O-Correct); (f) Performance on novel diagnoses (Precision@10, N-Correct).
